summary: Mounts the repository vulnerability exception policy into the protected Trivy container so exact release-candidate image scans can run fail closed.
userImpact: Protected releases no longer fail because the containerized candidate scan cannot read the checked-in Trivy ignore policy.
security: The scanner receives the read-only policy file at an explicit container path and still rejects every non-ignored vulnerability severity.
Candidate publication remains blocked when the policy file is absent, unreadable, or the scan fails.
documentation: Generated release notes record the protected candidate-scan correction and backward-compatible release impact.
rollback: Revert the workflow mount to disable the correction; no application, API, configuration, or database state changes are involved.
validation: Release-candidate workflow contract coverage requires the read-only Trivy policy mount and container path.
Local containerized Trivy invocation proves the mounted ignore policy is readable.
Protected merge-queue staging must scan the exact backend and frontend candidate digests before release publication.
